key_decisions: Switching from .repeat() to broadcasting in _apply_penalties to save memory bandwidth.
Using .gather() instead of advanced indexing in _get_ranks to potentially utilize more optimized CUDA kernels.
Specifying dtypes explicitly during tensor creation to avoid the overhead of Python-side type inference.

weaknesses: Skipped the explicit timing script step requested in the prompt (or at least didn't show the output)

prompting_improvements: Require the agent to output the results of the timing script to ensure empirical verification.
